preconditions: For quantity MOVES use stock_item_adjust (it writes the audit ledger); a direct quantity update is a correction and leaves no movement row.

description: Update a stock_item you own (optionally compare-and-set via expected_updated_at).

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

name: stock_item_update
